source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Set console through SOL (ttyS0)

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. SOL (ttyS0) should be set successfully.
2. Terminal should have correct output when connecting via SOL.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- COM 0 -> SOL: set Linux console through SOL (ttyS0). Agent verifies the current console/kernel cmdline sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "cat /proc/cmdline 2>&1; grep -E 'console' /etc/default/grub 2>&1"; setting/confirming the SOL (ttyS0) console output needs terminal access at the SOL (ttyS0) side.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the kernel cmdline + grub console settings so the user confirms console=SOL (ttyS0) is configured; the actual terminal output over SOL (ttyS0) is observed by the operator.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL correctly says actual SOL output is necessary, but only inspects host configuration through unsafe SSH and neither discovers/configures the BMC SOL payload nor opens a bounded session. It lacks channel/UART mapping, serial parameters, session ownership, reboot and recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / IMPROVED correctly adds BMC SOL identity, boot diff, protected session evidence and alternate recovery. This review retains package classification because the state-changing boot/reboot/session workflow requires explicit approval even though collection can be automated afterward.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 833/2291 keeps PARTIAL and a quoting repair but does not validate the BMC payload/channel, active-session conflict, output phases or clean deactivation.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-996 draft was inspected only as history. It classified FULLY AUTOMATABLE based on PTY capability but understated the mandatory user-confirmation boundary for boot changes, reboot and possible console-session disruption.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 preserves actual SOL output and rejects config-only substitution; ED-36 treats map/settings as readiness; ED-38 requires approval for reboot/state change, no automatic retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Configure the platform's ttyS0 console for its mapped BMC Serial-over-LAN payload and prove a protected SOL session receives correct, readable output through the required boot/OS phases and terminates cleanly.
original_method: An engineer approves the ttyS0-to-BMC SOL mapping, exact host/boot and BMC payload settings, session ownership and any reboot. A protected client then activates the bounded SOL session, captures output and optional bidirectional I/O, exits without leaving a stale payload and verifies recovery/final state.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer approves the console/SOL map, exact configuration, reboot and session takeover and owns recovery/readability verdict. After approval, automation may validate configuration, activate a bounded PTY SOL session, timestamp/redact output, test permitted input and close/deactivate cleanly.
required_inputs: Immutable host/BMC/firmware/OS identity and authoritative mapping among COM0/ttyS0, UART mux/CPLD/BIOS route, BMC SOL payload/channel and any physical/debug owner
Matching host and BMC serial settings: baud/bitrate, data, parity, stop, flow control, character encoding and volatile/nonvolatile SOL parameters
Current and proposed bootloader/kernel console ordering, getty/login service and BMC SOL enablement, with exact reviewed diff and persistence/activation behavior

Approved SOL client/version/interface/cipher/authentication, protected credentials, payload instance, privilege, existing-session ownership, reconnect policy, timeout, escape sequence and clean close/deactivate method
Required firmware/bootloader/kernel/init/login/interactive output phases, secret-redaction policy, backup boot entry, independent KVM/OOB recovery, reboot approval and final restore decision
Pinned accessible revision/hash and review of the internal com-0_sol Script before use
safety_requirements: Do not assume ttyS0 routes to the BMC SOL payload; verify the board mux and BMC channel map before changing either endpoint.
Do not alter bootloader/getty/BMC SOL settings or reboot until the exact diff, backup entry and independent KVM/OOB recovery are approved and proven.
Do not interrupt or deactivate an existing SOL session unless its owner and stale/active status are verified and takeover is explicitly authorized.
Protect BMC/host credentials and validate endpoint identities; do not use `sshpass`, disable SSH host-key checking or log IPMI passwords.
Bound the SOL session and output capture. Do not send arbitrary keystrokes, credentials, break sequences or power controls; permit only the approved non-destructive input checkpoint.
Treat `/proc/cmdline`, GRUB text and BMC SOL status as configuration evidence only; actual timestamped SOL characters and phase identity are required.
Preserve logs rather than clearing them and redact console secrets without removing evidence of sequence, corruption, duplication or loss.
The internal Script URL is preserved but inaccessible in this review; do not execute an unknown mutable script until content/hash/parameters/recovery are reviewed.

Do not automatically retry boot, activation or session creation. Stop on wrong payload, session conflict, unreadable/leaking output, boot/management loss or failed cleanup; use the approved alternate path and restore.
agent_execution_scope: Before approval, read host console/boot/getty and BMC SOL status/parameters and prepare exact reversible changes without applying them.
After approval, validate generated boot/BMC configuration, observe the single authorized activation/reboot and open a bounded PTY session to collect phase-tagged raw output.
Verify same host/session identity, permitted bidirectional interaction, orderly escape/close, payload inactive or intentionally retained and final host/BMC health.
Do not seize an existing session, make unapproved changes, reboot, send sensitive/control input, retry automatically or issue DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the ttyS0/SOL map, serial parameters, exact host/BMC diff, existing-session policy, reboot, output phases and recovery.
Authorize any session takeover and judge readable/correct output where human interpretation is required.
Restore or retain approved configuration, verify session/management health and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Host cmdline/GRUB reads are useful baseline only. The literal wrapper is unsafe and omits BMC SOL configuration, activation, transcript, session ownership and cleanup, so it cannot satisfy either Criteria item.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use host-key-verified protected access plus the platform-approved SOL client/API with explicit payload/channel, timeout and clean escape. Apply the exact host/BMC diff only after approval and capture raw PTY output without arbitrary input.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: COM0-to-SOL ttyS0 setting, correct terminal output, Script URL and 10/0-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Snapshot host/BMC state; validate mapping and matching serial parameters; apply the reviewed reversible changes; perform one approved activation/reboot; establish a bounded SOL PTY; capture required phases; perform permitted I/O; exit/deactivate cleanly; verify/restore state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact host ttyS0/UART mux, BMC SOL payload/channel, management network and bootloader/OS.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC/CPLD, kernel/bootloader/getty, SOL/IPMI client and internal Script revision/hash.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform UART/SOL routing and payload specification plus OS serial-console and approved client documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds BMC-side payload identity, session ownership, matching endpoint settings, automated bounded transcript, clean termination and recoverable activation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Host config alone does not prove SOL output; physical COM output does not prove SOL; opening a session without phase/readability evidence does not prove correct console routing.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Mapping/settings, host/BMC diff, client/session contract, phases, reboot/recovery, approval and Script review.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong mapping or session takeover can hide diagnostics, leak console content, disrupt another user or strand the system after reboot.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may use ipmitool, ipmiutil, a vendor SOL client or an approved console service if it exercises the same mapped payload and output stages. Record original and actual tool, approval, equivalence and any unverified client-specific coverage.
expected_evidence: Host/BMC/firmware identity, ttyS0/UART/mux/SOL payload/channel ownership map and pinned Script review
Matching host/BMC serial parameters, SOL enable/status and exact before/after bootloader/kernel/getty/BMC configuration diff
Approval and single activation/reboot timeline with backup entry and independent KVM/OOB recovery ready
Protected bounded SOL session metadata and raw redacted transcript covering every required phase plus allowed bidirectional I/O
Clean escape/close/deactivate evidence, absence of stale/conflicting payload, final boot/host/BMC health, restore/retained-state evidence and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target ttyS0 through BMC SOL. Missing channel mapping, settings, phases and session policy are Project readiness inputs rather than contradictory purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SOL routing and output objective are clear. Mapping, configuration, client and recovery inputs can be supplied; after approval, the network terminal evidence is automatable within a guarded workflow.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains host configuration reads but rejects them as complete proof and adds the missing BMC/session half.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on package/user confirmation and strengthens bounded PTY, session-ownership, clean-termination and Script controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Expands beyond quoting repair to validate actual SOL payload and output lifecycle.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Rejects unconditional FULLY AUTOMATABLE because boot/reboot/session disruption needs explicit user confirmation, while retaining automation after approval.

review_improvement: Prevents a correct host console string from passing when the BMC payload is wrong or silent, and prevents automated takeover, leaked boot output or stale SOL sessions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Unlike a physical COM endpoint, SOL bytes and lifecycle can be captured programmatically, but this source still entails state-changing console configuration, possible reboot and ownership of an interactive BMC payload. Those approval-dependent hazards place it in package/user confirmation; once authorized, transcript and cleanup are strong automated evidence rather than manual observation alone.
